card.name: Dates and fields in Unix listings
card.fires_on: Month names, numbers and separators inside technical listings such as ls -l file output, man page generation dates and catalog records. It fires on the field just before a day or time value.

modes.label: Month in file listings
modes.description: A month abbreviation in ls -l output or a man page date stamp, right before the day and time.

modes.label: Numbers and counters
modes.description: A number or digit inside a ranking or process list, just before a decimal or a rank figure.
modes.example: Total downloads13 ( #88,007 of 549,196 ) Recent downloads (6 months)1<< (>> #63,397 of

modes.label: Separators in records
modes.description: A dash or colon separating fields in catalog headings or error messages.
modes.example: /dev/cd1b<<:>> No such file or directory ls -

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated and mixed across languages.
card.plain: It fires on the month, number or punctuation inside computer file listings and system records, not on medical text.
